page.layout: One printed page of running text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at top: left "ritibus." (cut at the fold), centre "CAPUT XXI.", right page number 561. Signature "Nn" centred at the foot. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: hinc lucis aliquid accedere potest illis, quæ Dominus noster Jesus Christus in institutione sacræ cœnæ suæ fecit, maximè cùm in illius descriptione D. Lucas bis poculi mentionem facit. Primò igitur omnium Judæus paterfamilias, mensæ cum convivis suis accumbens, poculum vino refertum dextera manu apprehendit, atque mox ite[?] orare incipit: Benedictus sis tu Domine, Deus noster, rex mundi, qui creas fructum vitis. Hoc dicto, primus omnium vinum degustat: quod idem mox omnibus mensæ accumbentibus degustan-dum porrigit. Et hanc orationem sanctificatio-nem vocant, quâ Christus cœnam quoque suam exorsus est, Luc.22.v.17. Post calicis benedictio-nem, statim panem, quem integram massam esse oportet, accipit, eumque utraque manu tenen-do, his verbis consecrat: Benedictus sis, Domine Deus noster, qui educis panem è terra. Hoc dicto paterfa-miliâs paululum de pane edit, simulatque singu-lis mensæ accumbentibus buccellam de eo dis-tribuit. Quo facto, tum demum reliquis epulis manus injiciunt. Hunc benedicendi calicem & panem ritum, in festivis tantùm diebus obser-vant. Aliâs enim panem tantùm, & non pocu-lum consecrant. Sumptis epulis, ac finito convivio, gratias agunt: quod munus rursum sibi paterfamiliâs, aut honoratior aliquis inter con-vivas (honori enim ducitur) usurpat. Is pocu-lum vino repletum, utraque manu tenendo, sic orare incipit: Benedicamus, sive gratias agamus ei, qui nos de suo cibavit, & cujus bonitate vivimus. Hoc di-cto respondent convivæ: Benedictus sit ipse, cujus

page.notes: Doubtful: "ite" in "mox ite orare incipit" is read as "ite" with [?]; the word may be misprinted. Left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page's text and was not transcribed. A short stray dash in the right margin beside the line "paterfamiliâs, aut honoratior" is ink, not text, and was left out. The paragraph is not broken anywhere on the page, since no line is indented or ends short, so the whole page is one paragraph. The paragraph continues on the next page after "cujus". Hyphens at line ends are printed hyphens and were kept.
